reply.rationale: No defensible compositional paradigm is supported by this codebook. All symbols are length-2 forms, but shared initial or final letters do not show stable, predictable semantic contributions across minimal pairs. For example, symbols ending in C (RC, AC) do not share a clear common meaning, nor do symbols beginning with H (HI, HS) or P (PI, PS). Several glosses are heterogeneous bundles or opaque labels, and there is no substitution frame where contrasting fillers in the same position yield corresponding meaning contrasts. Under the evidence requirements, any segmentation here would be speculative, so the safest valid analysis is a flat lexicon.
